statement: Username or email login issues a bearer JWT on success; the UI stores it in an httpOnly sameSite=lax cookie and replaces the URL with next or /.
branches: unknown user or wrong password: 400 Invalid credentials, visible raw error, remain login
forbidden_side_effects: no account, cart, order, catalog or membership changes
failed fresh login must not create authenticated session

statement: All account mutations/reads require current user resolved from a valid JWT subject; UI 401 redirects preserve return target.
branches: invalid/expired JWT: 401 Invalid or expired token
anonymous collection click: login?next=/release/id; login does not replay collection POST
anonymous cart add: login returns to /cart?add=id, then retries add
forbidden_side_effects: refusals change no business state

statement: Sign out clears the cookie then refreshes/pushes home; it does not invalidate JWT server-side.
branches: sign out: cookie expiry and home
Header treats cookie presence as signed in without validating it
forbidden_side_effects: no business state mutations

statement: API registration validates schema and exact username/email uniqueness, hashes password, creates a user; there is no registration page.
preconditions: username length 3..50; valid email; password length 8..128; optional display_name <=120
forbidden_side_effects: no other users or business records change

statement: Search trims q, matches title or main artist using case-insensitive SQL substring pattern, sorts year descending/null last then title, limits 30; it does not search genre/style/label.
branches: no match: empty grid without explicit no-result sentence
forbidden_side_effects: no database changes

statement: Release detail returns joined metadata, ordered tracks and current global collection/want counts plus active listing count/minimum price.
branches: exists: metadata, tracklist, optional notes and actions
missing: API 404 Release not found; apiGet throws; exact Next error UI pending
forbidden_side_effects: read does not mutate tables

statement: Home ranks most wanted (6), latest created (8), and highest order-item prices in last 31 days (6); promo tiles link home, featured banner links seeded title if available.
branches: rankings data-dependent, ties not fully stable
newsletter Subscribe has no handler/form action; app store mockups are display only
forbidden_side_effects: no newsletter subscription or database mutation from placeholder controls

statement: Genre overview includes alphabetic styles, most-collected and earliest-year cards, decade and contributor aggregates, recent-sales ranking. Its navigation links lead to text search, not true genre-filtered search.
branches: unknown: API 404 Genre not found; exact Next error UI pending
style/release/artist links are q text searches
forbidden_side_effects: no catalog/business mutations

statement: collection GET returns current user release cards; POST is idempotent; DELETE removes only current user membership and succeeds when absent. UI only exposes add and list, no remove control.
forbidden_side_effects: other users/membership kind and all catalog/cart/order/listing rows unchanged

statement: wantlist GET returns current user release cards; POST is idempotent; DELETE removes only current user membership and succeeds when absent. UI only exposes add and list, no remove control.
forbidden_side_effects: other users/membership kind and all catalog/cart/order/listing rows unchanged

statement: Successful Add to Collection/Wantlist always increments its local component count, including duplicate POST no-op; the separate summary remains its server-rendered value until navigation/reload.
branches: repeat add: local count +1 again; durable count unchanged
forbidden_side_effects: duplicates must not create another membership

statement: Marketplace exposes only active listings for a release; text filters are exact equality, rating is minimum, sorting is price_asc/price_desc/newest with documented secondary keys.
preconditions: sort enum; API limit 1..200 default50, offset>=0
branches: none: No listings match these filters.
bad sort/nonnumeric rating/pagination 422 -> server page error
UI has no pagination or quantity control and renders at most default 50
forbidden_side_effects: no state changes from filtering/sorting

statement: Add requires active listing and positive quantity; an existing user/listing row accumulates quantity capped at 99; a new row is not capped by the route. No stock or seller-self-purchase check exists.
branches: UI always adds one via /cart?add=id and replaces /cart
UI ignores non-401 add refusal then loads cart
forbidden_side_effects: no order or stock decrement; no other users cart changes

statement: Cart joins current listing price, calculates sum(price*cart quantity), returns currency USD, latest-added first. UI hides quantity and displays unit prices alongside total.
branches: empty UI message and Checkout disabled
same listing twice yields one visible row but doubled total
forbidden_side_effects: read never creates orders or changes listing

statement: Remove deletes only the logged-in user cart row by cart_item_id, then UI reloads; absent/other-user IDs are successful no-ops.
forbidden_side_effects: no listing/order changes; other users cart unchanged

statement: Checkout snapshots current listing prices and cart quantities into one paid USD order, marks each entire listing sold, leaves listing.quantity unchanged, clears only buyer cart, commits once.
preconditions: nonempty cart, every listing still active
branches: 400 A listing in your cart is no longer available; session closes without commit, pending flushed order should roll back
UI reload then alert Checkout complete (order created).
UI has no order history/detail page
forbidden_side_effects: no listing quantity decrement
no changes to unrelated listings/orders/cart/memberships/catalog
refusal must not leave partial order or sold statuses

statement: Authenticated seller creates active listing for existing release. Schema accepts arbitrary nonempty conditions, positive cents, three-character currency, origin 1..80, optional comments and qty1..99. UI fixes currency USD.
branches: UI create disabled when no selected or cents<=0; invalid qty still submits
UI price field represents cents, not dollars
forbidden_side_effects: no modifications to existing listings or other business tables

statement: My Listings includes all own statuses sorted newest first; Deactivate is soft deletion (inactive), including already inactive/sold own rows. Missing/non-owned returns 404.
preconditions: valid session; owned listing to deactivate
branches: DELETE 200 {ok:true}, row retained and visible inactive
forbidden_side_effects: no physical row deletion; no changes to other sellers listings or orders/cart

statement: API PATCH updates explicitly supplied schema fields on owned listing; status permits active/inactive, even reactivating sold. Fields nullable in schema can reach non-null SQL columns and cause DB failure.
preconditions: valid session; own listing; schema-valid partial body
branches: explicit null non-null-column fields: potential SQL 500 rollback, browser unverified
forbidden_side_effects: no other listing changes
interface: API only; UI provides no edit/reactivate control

statement: Seller search uses /api/backend/search?q=..., but generic proxy builds upstream URL from path only and drops query. Backend search requires q, so expected 422 prevents selection/creation through normal seller search.
preconditions: original proxy route wins Next routing
branches: expected 422 missing q; visible JSON error; selected remains unset
if runtime routing differs record counterexample and revise; do not bypass UI with API/DOM injected state
forbidden_side_effects: failed search must not create listing

statement: Accept All Cookies writes localStorage acceptance and hides banner; Cookie Settings has no handler.
branches: accept: hidden, remains hidden on reload when storage works
storage unavailable: hide current mount but return later
forbidden_side_effects: no backend business changes

statement: Desktop menus reveal on hover. Header has catalog search, cart, account and sell/genre links. Footer/community links mostly target unimplemented routes, social links are #.
preconditions: desktop viewport for hidden md:flex nav
forbidden_side_effects: no implied business capability for dead links

statement: Users UUID PK, releases/artists/labels/genres/styles integer PK; releases link tracks, artists with roles, labels, genres, styles, formats; membership composite keys and cart uniqueness constrain duplicates. Comments table exists but no comment API or functional comment UI.
branches: SQL relation declarations do not prove SQLite FK enforcement; engine has no PRAGMA listener
no mutation APIs for catalog, comments, profile or order cancellation
forbidden_side_effects: UI interactions must not modify read-only catalog/comment entities

statement: Original Next16.1.1/React19.2.3 frontend reads API_INTERNAL_URL first and no-store catalog fetches; backend settings default SQLite and 24h JWT. Actual runtime manifest controls versions/ports, not conflicting README values.
branches: SQL session closes on every request
no database writes from public reads
external Unsplash image failures separate from local business correctness
generic proxy forwards explicit Authorization but does not attach cookie JWT; dedicated account proxies do
forbidden_side_effects: do not expose JWT/password hashes in evidence
